INSERT INTO point_deployment ( point_tmpl_id, device_deploy_id, alarm_code, point_name, n4_address, point_code, register, point_type, data_type, unit, display_precision ) VALUES
(#{p.pointTmplId}, #{p.deviceDeployId}, #{p.alarmCode}, #{p.pointName}, #{p.n4Address}, #{p.pointCode}, #{p.register}, #{p.pointType}, #{p.dataType}, #{p.unit}, #{p.displayPrecision})
mapper.update: UPDATE point_deployment SET alarm_code = #{alarmCode}, point_name = #{pointName}, n4_address = #{n4Address}, point_code = #{pointCode}, register = #{register}, point_type = #{pointType}, data_type = #{dataType}, unit = #{unit}, display_precision = #{displayPrecision}, update_time = NOW() WHERE point_deploy_id = #{pointDeployId}
